queries_run: Chipotle tariff impact 2026 avocados beef costs

findings.claim: 10-K 載明部分食材（酪梨、番茄、牛肉、豬肉、萊姆、辣椒、香料）、設備與包材來自美國境外（墨西哥、加拿大、中國），可能面臨關稅、貿易制裁或稅負上升。
findings.excerpt: we source some ingredients (including avocados, tomatoes, beef, pork, limes, peppers and spices), restaurant equipment, packaging and paper products outside the U.S. (including from Mexico, Canada and China), which could subject them to increased tariffs, trade sanctions or taxes.

findings.claim: 2025 年已實施關稅使食品飲料包材成本占營收比增加 0.2 個百分點，公司估計持續性影響約 15 bps。
findings.excerpt: We estimate that the tariffs enacted in 2025 will impact food, beverage and packaging costs by about 15 basis points on an ongoing basis. These estimates could vary based on future tariff policy changes.

findings.claim: 公司約一半酪梨來自哥倫比亞、秘魯、多明尼加，非墨西哥；CEO 表示傾向吸收關稅成本、維持菜單價格（2025 年初報導）。
findings.source: NBC News: Chipotle downplays looming Trump tariffs, says only half of its avocados are from Mexico
findings.excerpt: Chipotle buys about half of its avocado supply from Colombia, Peru and the Dominican Republic
